results.description:
She's sunshine with a mind of her own. He's a single dad who doesn't do casual. Falling in love was never part of the plan.

Mason Herriot has exactly two priorities: his daughter and the veterinary practice he's building from the ground up. There's no room in his life for anything else—until Delilah Daniels walks into his clinic mid-crisis, holding a dog that isn't even hers, and he asks her out before he can talk himself out of it.

Delilah doesn't do serious. She's spent her whole life avoiding the kind of ties that come with strings attached, and a single dad with a young daughter and a struggling practice is about as tied-down as it gets. But there's something about Mason's steadiness that she can't quite walk away from.

They agree to keep it casual. The problem is, Mason's not built for casual—and the more time Delilah spends in his world, the more she starts to wonder if the life she's been avoiding might actually be the one she wants. 

She's the sun. And he may get burned.

Perfect for fans of Christina Lauren and Lauren Layne

"A sexy romp of a romance novel that also manages to take a look at some tough, worthy questions about what it takes to build and sustain—not only joyful, organically heartfelt relationships—but also a joyful, organically heartfelt life." — IndieReader, Best Reviewed Books of May 2020

Finding Delilah is the third book in the interconnected West Side Series. Each book follows a different couple and can be enjoyed as a complete standalone.

Originally titled Walk the Dog.
